standard-dialogue-before-plague-city.npc: Not too bad... I've just got some troubles on my mind...

standard-dialogue-after-plague-city.npc: Thank you for rescuing my daughter! Elena has told me of your bravery in entering a house that could have been plague infected. I can't thank you enough!

standard-dialogue-after-mourning-s-end-p.npc: Elena! They came and took her away!

standard-dialogue-after-mourning-s-end-p.player: Oh no! Is there anything I can do?

standard-dialogue-after-mourning-s-end-p.npc: I'm not sure... Speak to Edmond, he was there when they took her.

standard-dialogue-after-song-of-the-elve.npc: Thank you so much for helping Elena. It means so much to Edmond and I.

options.condition: If the player doesn't have a tabard in their possession:

steps.npc: Not a problem. I still have enough materials to make another. Here you go.

steps.text: Alrena gives you a Knight of Ardougne tabard.
